prompts.radial: Use case: ui-mockup. Production game UI sprite, not a concept screenshot. The reference image is the existing game's button frame: match its pixel-art warm wood, dark charcoal interior, brass trim, small iron rivets, restrained western train aesthetic. Orthographic front view, crisp pixel edges, no perspective, no text, no labels, no numbers, no watermark. Truly transparent background outside the asset, no checkerboard, no shadow haze. Keep ample transparent edge padding. Blank interiors for game-rendered labels. One large circular six-section radial menu ring centered on a square image. Exactly six equal 60-degree annular wedges separated by thin brass radial seams. One wedge points straight UP, its borders at -120 and -60 degrees; remaining wedges evenly clockwise. Outer circular radius 45% of image width, inner circular hole radius 17% of image width. Inner hole completely transparent. All six wedge interiors identical dark charcoal. Subtle wood outer rim, thin gold outer and inner borders. No icons, handles, tabs, title, center button or other elements. Ring fills 90% of square width.

prompts.icons: Use case: ui-mockup. Production pixel-art GUI icon atlas on a transparent square canvas. EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells, every cell occupied by exactly one separate icon centered in its own cell. Uniform grid spacing, all cells same size, no grid lines. Each icon confined to central 60 percent of its cell, clear empty margins; no overlap or extra icons. Color: warm ivory with small dark brown outline and restrained brass accents, crisp legible simple pixel-art pictograms matching a western train game. No text, letters, numbers, backgrounds, shadows, checkerboard or panels. Exact row-major icons: ROW1 seated person (poses); exit doorway with arrow pointing right; steam locomotive with small forward arrow (travel); backpack. ROW2 folded map; three horizontal dots (more); standing person; seated person on chair. ROW3 person lying flat; open hand (use); crossed wrench and hammer (train tools); open journal. ROW4 gear (settings); X (cancel); two vertical pause bars; six dots arranged in a ring (actions launcher). All 16 distinct requested pictograms. Center all at consistent cell centers, uniform apparent size.
